lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A bench against the wall by the lift. You have eaten lunch on it most working days for eleven years.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: If I close this quarter and go home, I eat lunch here tomorrow. That is genuinely the choice, and I am genuinely thinking about it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You already ran the reconciliation. That is the part that cannot be un-run.
